## Change summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is placed in the appropriate feature module.
- [ ] Board/device variants are updated if needed.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` is updated for user-visible behavior.
- [ ] A note under `docs/changes/` is added for a meaningful change.
- [ ] `docs/FEATURES.md` is updated if feature support or version changed.
- [ ] `docs/DEVICE_MATRIX.md` is updated if hardware support changed.
- [ ] Local builds pass for the affected environments.
- [ ] No credentials or secrets are included.
